note: S78 is GRADE D: arithmetic over inputs measured in S77, plus one E input read from pathmap source. Published as a threshold, never as a measured byte count.

controls.name: C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_digest
controls.must_fire_because: the whole question is whether a physical commitment charges per NODE or per SIBLING; the source states the composition and the loop implements it, so this is decidable without a measurement
controls.can_fail_because: the composition comment is absent, or the loop does not hash a (path, child_hash) pair per child, i.e. the node hash is not built from its children's digests one at a time
controls.null_must_contain: merkleization.rs, which is equally free to hash a fixed child array, a 256-slot map, or every node on the path -- any of which would charge a digest per node and flip this

controls.name: C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones
controls.must_fire_because: this spike computes rather than measures, so its inputs must be the reviewed spikes' committed numbers and not retyped prose -- retyping a number out of a page is D6 hole H5 performed on purpose
controls.can_fail_because: any set is missing from S77/measure.json or any sibling/depth value is absent or non-numeric
controls.null_must_contain: S77's measure.json, whose values this spike reads and cannot adjust

controls.name: C_threshold_is_decision_relevant
controls.must_fire_because: a threshold outside any framing anyone would build answers nothing in either direction, and publishing it would be a number with no decision attached
controls.can_fail_because: the flip threshold falls outside 1.0-32.0 B per node
controls.null_must_contain: a computed F free to land anywhere: below 1 B (even a length field flips the ordering, so S77 needs qualifying) or above 32 B (a full digest per node would not flip it, so the caveat was never a risk)

controls.name: C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing
controls.must_fire_because: S77's inversion is the retraction; if a 1-2 B segment length per physical node undoes it, the retraction is specific to the logical view and must say so
controls.can_fail_because: the flip threshold is at or below 2 B per physical node
controls.null_must_contain: the atom trie's 139.1 physical nodes per path against the triples' 10.3 -- a 13x gap with ample room to overturn a 785 B sibling gap
